fleetPanel.description: Les serveurs Ready Up s’inscrivent eux-mêmes avec un code à usage unique ou une clé de flotte, puis restent connectés à la plateforme. Aucun mot de passe RCON nécessaire.

failover.title: Failover
failover.moved: The match is moving. Players see the new server on the match page.
failover.inPlace: It resumes the match on the same server, from {{round}}.
failover.noServer: No Ready Up server is free. The match moves as soon as one is (or when this one comes back).

failoverSettings.title: Failover
failoverSettings.saveFailed: Could not save the failover settings
failoverSettings.autoHelp: When a Ready Up server goes down during a match, the match resumes from the last round backup: on the same server if it comes back in time, else on a free one. Off: the match page asks an admin first.
failoverSettings.csm: Restart and create servers through csm
failoverSettings.csmHelp: Before moving a match, csm restarts the server that went down and the match waits up to 90 s for it. When no server is free, csm creates one on a machine with room.
failoverSettings.reserveStatus: {{effective}} of {{pool}} online server(s) kept free for failover
failoverSettings.reserveHelp: Spare servers stay idle: matches are not put on them, so one is ready when a server goes down. At least one server always takes matches. Spare servers count toward your license like any other server.
